gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: Everyone says she takes ___ her grandmother.
gaps.explanation: take after a relative = resemble them in character/looks.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).
